sign: A bridge over nothing at all, lit by lanterns paid for by the families of those who fell.
toll_boy: Kasimir: Half the toll now, half when you reach the other side. If you don't, Veronne keeps the first half.
toll_boy_intro: Kasimir: No coins? Then I'll take it in battle. Veronne's rules.
toll_boy_defeat: Kasimir: Paid in full. Don't look down.
